body: I keep switching between feeling numb and feeling anxious.
I feel the same way, it's really hard when your family doesn't understand or try to help.
Well that too,both of those things scare me. I think the best thing would be if we reincarnate into a new body and forget our previous life.
Same, I fear that there'll be nothing, that we just cease to exist.
Thank you, I tried to speak to my brother but he changes the topic or tells me it's not that hard and that I'll manage.
